messages:
maya: kicking off security checklist for the new eu6 GPU cluster bring-up. aim is handoff-ready by EOD. short list below and current blockers.

samir: thanks — can you paste the runbook link? also need the KMS key name we'll use for CEK/CMEK.

maya: runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/eu6-provisioning (draft). KMS key will be projects/redwood-eu6/locations/global/keyRings/infra-secrets/cryptoKeys/eu6-hsm-key (HSM-backed).

leah: quick validation items from sec: 1) service accounts scoped down 2) no plaintext secrets in terraform state accessible 3) KMS key access limited to ops and vault 4) audit logs enabled to separate bucket.

samir: adding specifics — for SA perms: compute instances + node pools should use a node-sa that only has roles/compute.instanceAdmin.v1 and roles/iam.serviceAccountUser; workloads should map to workload SAs via node identity or K8s KSA->GSA.

tony: for Vault integration we mount the GCP KMS transit key, but we need to ensure key_signer role is not granted to anyone except vault-sa. also rotate key versions after initial bootstrap.

ops-bot: auto-check: iam bindings scan started against project redwood-eu6. found potential broad binding: roles/owner on service-account infra-admin@redwood-eu6. Flagged.

maya: noted — that's from an old terraform module. samir / leah can you confirm we can remove owner binding and grant roles/iam.serviceAccountAdmin only to infra-deploy group?

leah: yes remove owner. recommend: grant roles/iam.serviceAccountAdmin + roles/resourcemanager.projectIamAdmin only to a small ops-admin group, everything else via short-lived grants.

samir: network stuff — private cluster with no public nodes, master authorized networks set to our VPN ranges, and egress via NAT gateway in a shared VPC. Need firewall rules locked down so hub spokes only accept gRPC/SSH from bastion.

maya: confirmed. also ensure node metadata is disabled: --no-legacy-endpoints and shielded VMs enabled.

tony: secrets: terraform state will be in gs://redwood-terraform-eu6 with CMEK set to eu6-hsm-key. Ensure bucket IAM has no legacyReader and only terraform-sa has storage.objectAdmin. Also enable object versioning and lifecycle encryption.

leah: KMS IAM: run this to bind Vault:

leah: ```
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding eu6-hsm-key --keyring=infra-secrets --location=global --member=serviceAccount:vault-sa@redwood-eu6.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter
```

samir: also bind decrypt to the node SAs that need to unwrap image secrets:

samir: ```
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding eu6-hsm-key --keyring=infra-secrets --location=global --member=serviceAccount:node-sa@redwood-eu6.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter
```

ops-bot: compliance check: audit logs to secure-buckets redwood-logs-eu6 configured: true. bucket encryption: CMEK (eu6-hsm-key). retention: 365d.

maya: perf/cost note — GPU node pools are N1-standard for control plane? we're using T4s to start. need auto-scaler min=0 max=50 and a burst pool for priority traffic. Confirm cost center tagging on all instances.

tony: tagging done. also add the cost center label to GKE node pools and GPUs: labels: ci=ai, cost_center=ml-team.

leah: final checklist for handoff to security: 1) remove infra-admin owner binding (samir) 2) confirm KMS bindings only to vault-sa and node-sa (leah) 3) terraform bucket IAM + CMEK (maya) 4) network ACLs + master auth (samir) 5) audit logs + log sink (ops-bot) 6) run threat model quick scan (infra-oncall).

infra-oncall: will run the threat-model scanner at 18:00 UTC and post results.

maya: blocker — one terraform module still uses project editor role for legacy deployments. samir can you take a look and PR to replace with least-priv roles?

samir: on it, will open PR in 30m.

leah: once PR merges, I'll re-run the IAM scan, then we can request security sign-off.

ops-bot: iam scan result (post-PR): no roles/owner/editor bindings outside ops-admin group. pass: true.

maya: great — prepping handoff doc for security review. target review window 19:00 UTC.

samir: FYI, small note about HSM key usage: we set primary protection level to HSM and disable key export. ensure SOC aware of this in the signoff.

leah: acknowledged. I'll include KMS key ARN and rotation schedule in the handoff.

maya: thanks everyone — if no other blockers we'll mark this as ready for security review at 19:00 UTC. :thumbsup:
